notre-dame.name: Notre-Dame de la Garde
notre-dame.hours: Basilica roughly 07:00–18:00; check on the day
notre-dame.tip: Walk up from the Vieux-Port for the best city and sea views. Go early to beat the crowds.

mucen.name: MuCEM
mucen.tip: The rooftop terrace and the footbridge to Fort Saint-Jean are worth the visit alone.

velodrome.name: Orange Vélodrome
velodrome.price_text: ≈ €15 for a stadium tour; match tickets vary
velodrome.hours: Tour times vary; check on the day
velodrome.tip: Book a stadium tour or catch an OM match if you can. Check the schedule before you go.
velodrome.best: Match day or a weekday tour

magic-park.name: Magic Park Land (El Dorado City)
magic-park.landmark: Magic Park Land (aka: El Dorado City)
magic-park.price_text: ≈ €20–30 per person; check on the day
magic-park.tip: A family theme park outside the city. Check transport and opening days before you go.

ok-corral.name: OK Corral
ok-corral.price_text: ≈ €20–30 per person; check on the day
ok-corral.tip: A Western-themed family park well outside the city. Plan a car or long trip.

vieux-port.name: Vieux-Port and fish market
vieux-port.tip: Come in the morning for the fish stalls along the quay. Watch the boats and the mirror canopy.

le-panier.name: Le Panier old quarter walk
le-panier.tip: Wander the narrow streets and street art. Go in the morning before it gets hot.

calanques-boat.name: Calanques boat trip
calanques-boat.price_text: ≈ €25–40 for a short cruise; check on the day
calanques-boat.tip: Book a boat trip from the Vieux-Port to see the rocky coves. Bring sun protection.

la-canebiere.name: La Canebière and Noailles walk
la-canebiere.tip: Walk the main street down to the port and explore the Noailles market streets.

prado-beach.name: Prado beaches
prado-beach.tip: A long city beach with free access. Go early on hot summer days.

borley.name: Bouillabaisse dinner
borley.tip: Try the classic fish stew at a proper restaurant near the port. Book ahead.

fort-saint-jean.name: Fort Saint-Jean viewpoint
fort-saint-jean.price_text: Free to enter the fort grounds
fort-saint-jean.tip: Walk the ramparts for sea views and the footbridge to MuCEM.

palais-longchamp.name: Palais Longchamp
palais-longchamp.price_text: Free to see the monument and gardens
palais-longchamp.hours: Park roughly 07:00–20:00; check on the day
palais-longchamp.tip: See the grand fountain and gardens. A calm break from the busy port.

cours-julien.name: Cours Julien street-art walk
cours-julien.tip: Look for murals and small bars. Best in the late afternoon and evening.

navette-maritime.name: Ferry to Pointe Rouge
navette-maritime.price_text: ≈ €5 one way; check on the day
navette-maritime.tip: A cheap boat ride along the coast. Check the timetable before you go.

abbaye-saint-victor.name: Abbaye Saint-Victor
abbaye-saint-victor.tip: A quiet old abbey with crypts. Go in the morning for calm.

la-major.name: La Major cathedral
la-major.tip: A striped stone cathedral near the port. Step inside for the light.

noailles-market.name: Marché de Noailles
noailles-market.price_text: Free to browse; food priced per item
noailles-market.tip: A busy market for spices, fruit and cheap eats. Come hungry in the morning.

chateau-if.name: Château d'If boat trip
chateau-if.price_text: ≈ €15–20 including boat; check on the day
chateau-if.tip: Take the boat to the island fortress from the Vieux-Port. Bring water and sun protection.

corniche.name: Corniche Kennedy walk
corniche.tip: A seaside walk with swimming spots below. Go at sunset.
